patch_description:
The current ansatz uses 24 independent parameters per block (8 RY + 8 RZ pre + 8 RZ post), leading to 144 circuit parameters total. While achieving perfect accuracy, this is parameter-inefficient.

I propose:
1. Use shared RY parameters across pairs of qubits (4 shared params instead of 8)
2. Use shared RZ parameters before entanglement (4 shared params instead of 8)
3. Replace the linear CZ chain with a more efficient pattern: add parametrized XX gates on complementary pairs to create richer entanglement with fewer parameters
4. Remove the post-RZ layer entirely (8 params saved)

This reduces parameters per block from 24 to 12 (50% reduction), giving 72 circuit params + 2 readout = 74 total params, improving parameter efficiency from 0.01 to ~0.0135 while maintaining accuracy.

The XX gates provide better expressiveness than fixed CZ gates and allow the optimizer to learn the optimal entanglement strength.
